task_message:
Case V09: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 161x161x156 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case V09 segmentation is complete.

**Summary:**
- **Finding:** A well-circumscribed, T2-hyperintense soft-tissue mass (~8.7 mL, ~27 mm) located in the anterolateral subcutaneous/perifascial region of the limb, with a thick bright rim and heterogeneous hypointense core — consistent with a vascular soft-tissue tumor.
- **Method:** Located the lesion on axial slices ~37–65 via contact sheets, seeded it with two positive points on the mass center, verified coverage with zoomed views in all three planes, and applied one refine pass (v2) that trimmed slight over-coverage.
- **Verification:** The final review showed clean past-the-mask panels on axial, coronal and sagittal planes, a single connected component, no stray regions, and no candidate corrections. A separate small superficial bright focus and a thin bright fascial/vascular streak were judged non-contiguous and excluded.
- **Confidence:** medium — the boundary follows the bright rim well on the axial plane; the coronal/sagittal reformats are slightly blurred, leaving mild uncertainty at the extreme ends.
